Title: Fewer than 5% of the HTTP requests fail while the load increases
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 10, 20, 40, 60 VUs, 1 min per step. Report run: 10 % of the users, 8 s per step (`-e SCALE=0.1 -e STEP=8s`, peak 6 VUs)
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/stress.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_failed: rate<0.05` holds. Less than 5% of all HTTP requests failed.

Title: 95% of the requests answer in under 3000 ms while the load increases
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 10, 20, 40, 60 VUs, 1 min per step. Report run: 10 % of the users, 8 s per step (`-e SCALE=0.1 -e STEP=8s`, peak 6 VUs)
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/stress.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_duration: p(95)<3000` holds. The 95th percentile of the request duration is under 3000 ms.
